sloka: अथ उत्तरम् उदार अर्थम् अब्रवीत् अंगदः तदा ।अनुमान्य महाप्राज्ञो जांबवंतम् महाकपिम् ॥४-६५-१८॥
transliteration: atha uttaram udāra artham abravīt aṁgadaḥ tadā ।anumānya mahāprājño jāṁbavaṁtam mahākapim ॥4-65-18॥

translations.english: 'Then the wise Angada said to great Jambavan, in a gentle manner about his own strength.
